description: She wears an opaque dark reddish brown long gown with a low square neckline, fitted bodice, elbow-length sleeves and a full floor-length skirt. Narrow dark and gold floral woven borders decorate the neckline, cuffs, central skirt opening and hem. An ivory underdress shows through the skirt opening. A modest decorated belt with small round fittings marks the waist. An ivory textured wrap edged in matching brown and gold hangs around the forearms and down both sides. Plain brown leather closed shoes appear beneath the hem. Exact textile fiber is uncertain; the cloth appears substantial and woven.
